title: Vignette 2026-11-04: the next persona is the reader, a person who has been sent an essay; what if we could share a view link?

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
The next persona is the reader. A person who has been sent an essay. 
For now, we offer the copy/export option to convert an srs essay into something normal. 

But what if we were able to share a view link? 
If an essay is published to google or dropbox or a public repo and a link to an essay is shared, what does a viewer need to see,
